name: slack_post_highlight
description: Post a highlight to the team channel. Only for moments a human should know about: stuck, needs approval, PR ready for review, done. One message per moment, linking back to the ticket. Never for routine progress.

headline.description: e.g. 'Atlas is stuck on WIT-142: missing OKTA_CLIENT_SECRET in staging'

detail.description: 1-2 lines. What happened and what's needed.
